article:
> **Key takeaways**
>
> - BassiTech Solutions describes itself as an Abuja-based technology consulting company offering strategy, software, proposals and digital skills. [c1]
> - It says its Digital Wings Initiative is an AI-focused digital skills programme in Taraba State. [c3]
> - The programme is designed for 100 young people. [c4]
> - It runs for 12 weeks. [c5]

## What it does

The company says it serves businesses and organisations in fintech, telecoms, agriculture and media. [c2]

### Digital Wings Initiative

BassiTech says the initiative is an AI-focused digital skills programme in Taraba State. [c3] It is designed for 100 young people [c4] and runs for 12 weeks. [c5]

### Other work

The company says it has designed 2 farming programmes for Kudan LGA, [c6] and its site lists 5 projects and ventures in total. [c7]

## Who is behind it

BassiTech says it is led by founder Anas Abubakar Bassi, a Computer Engineer who studied at Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. [c8]
